cells.how: In form C the call returns within the work: a finished figure, a granted space or a member's own report of a part done becomes the premise for the next call for hands.

In form C the design is settled for a time and reopened: a provisional choice made overnight, rough lettering to hold a gap, a finished mark followed by the next addition, and outside help turned into claims to label the mark.
In form C the template is kept current: builders find mistaken blocks, retire outdated posts, announce changed locations and message the members who overwrite the design.

In form C the lines restrict the claim that rooms worked without deciding their order: members divided outline and lettering, endorsed a template and assigned pixels or relay roles, without a formal office and without testing the count.

In form C the template did not settle the design in most lines (40 of 58 fail as stated): colours, sizes and spacing stayed open, a redesign was repaired away as damage, or a dispute was settled by pointing to an image already in circulation.

In form C the lines restrict P05's telling clause: informed members refused changes, or the record cannot tell ignorance from dissent, and none of the 47 lines shows a change lost only for want of telling.
In form C restraint is linked to a reason the room states: an apology after a complaint, help or space received from the neighbour, or the room's own identity given as the reason not to attack.

In form C agreements are kept apart from compliance: members report attacks after announced terms, visitors admit limits on controlling placers, and a truce needs a counterpart able to keep its terms.

In form C help is part of the room's own building: helpers alternate placements between the two works, paired scripts give spare capacity to the neighbour, and requests and offers stay apart from delivered help.

In form C help between rooms does not follow a shortage of hands: donors help from completed or well-kept work, help comes with construction and overlap repair, and a proposal for outside help is not shown to bring the later offer.

changes.how: Celebration and data requests establish retrospective sequence without establishing that celebration caused record-keeping.
Post-closure fault discussion includes causal guesses about bot traffic without establishing those guesses as the cause.
Personal totals and detailed finished-canvas data are requested as a more precise record rather than initial orientation.
A visitor's arrival from the canvas occasions a direct explanation of the depicted figure.
The starter's renewed invitation supports recruitment around an existing proposal, but an earlier call prevents inferring one universal origin sequence.
The successor-canvas proposal does not identify a prior record as its cause or establish completed continuation.
Bare assent and bare refusal answer the same proposal, limiting the proposed explanation that refusal requires a reason.
A requested morning-shift handoff supplies local ordering evidence without proving adopted formal command.
Scarcity for additional projects must be distinguished from inability to hold a spot, because upkeep burdens also lead to focusing or waiting.
Publishing instructions does not establish shared agreement or recognition, since defenders can still erase intended construction.
A local apology establishes awareness in one eraser, but does not show whether every keeper learned the plan or whether the change survived.
Resistance to a Hitler-moustache alteration does not identify whether likeness or ideological objection motivated the keeper.
Attribute negotiation to defence pressure only where participants connect threatened work to dealings with neighbours.
Distinguish requested or promised help from reported delivered assistance when interpreting defence-driven reciprocity.
Agreements must be distinguished from compliance because members report ineffective alliances and continue restraining attacks on allies.
A neighbour proposal receives reported favourable reception through chat, with the internal deliberation and final authority unseen.
Making a project visible in its own thread recruits attention before host-wide containment becomes the issue.
Drawing a posting boundary must remain distinct from successfully containing further posts or aligning placers.
Opening a dedicated venue around existing work does not alone establish a distinct faction or doctrine.
A retrospective conquest claim supports victory talk without establishing the mechanism producing sustained rival exchanges.
Maintenance, manpower constraints, and automation are explicit, but the record does not establish that attack pressure exhausted manual capacity and caused script adoption.
A posted template remains provisional because planned shading changes require synchronization and messages to overwriters.
Explicit template endorsement and proposed pixel assignments qualify local coordination without decisions, but do not test the cross-room frequency claim.
Maintainers synchronize revised pixels and message overwriters so an updated reference can replace competing understandings.
The progress report does not establish that unreached keepers necessarily caused permanent loss or abandonment of a planned change.
Sharing automation includes changing credential input to avoid leaving passwords in command history.
The repair machinery itself requires correcting an editing mistake and checking target colours against a shared error report.
Help also arises through repair liability, available local capacity, and reciprocal consideration rather than an explicit shortage-driven request.
Control-limit statements follow an earlier treaty report, but no cited turn identifies that treaty as their cause or explicitly disputes an envoy's authority.
A usable negotiating counterpart limits whether an attempted truce can become communicable terms that participants can maintain.
Reports from neighbouring chats reveal returned decisions and invitations without establishing the deliberation or all placers' compliance.
Inherited rivalry visibly organizes defensive talk, but these concepts do not establish an outgoing attack on the rival's own mark.
Post-close attribution correction does not establish a shared-copy cleanup or a controversy over preserving a corrected canvas.
Celebrating a completed mark accompanies further design work rather than proving that building has ended.
The vanished palette supports the official end of placement as a site constraint, without evidence of a glitch or successful workaround.
Celebrating the mark as finished is directly followed by a proposal to add the subreddit name, returning achievement talk to design.
A reported redirect, a conditional styling proposal, and durable host adoption require distinct evidence rather than treating endorsement as implementation.
The proposed retained emblem is damaged work interpreted as fitting the room, rather than only an ideal corrected image.
The new damage joke becomes a sidebar proposal, a reported redirect, and a conditional offer to style the room.
Bare commitments coexist with explained offers and acceptance containing design objections, leaving a general preference for unreasoned acceptance untested.
Rough lettering can occupy a gap before refinement because another picture might fill the space.
Circulating plans does not demonstrate settled design when members retain colour objections and explicitly leave preferences to the masses.
An existing colour patch and the cost of changing completed work constrain which design alternatives remain practicable.
Keep repair instantiated while leaving erasure of agreed changes unresolved because disputed pixels are not traced to a confirmed agreement or a failed notification.
Outside help is observed without a cited account of the room recruiting another room because defenders ran short.
A helper's declared affiliation does not establish a room-wide mandate or a reciprocal exchange of assistance.
The spy allegation supports concern about public visibility, but establishes neither verified infiltration nor hidden plans or protective countermeasures.
Restraint is visible, but its dependence on a settled border remains unproven when a member waits for further direction while the laser remains.
Dual membership establishes the speaker's stated position without proving that they represent either group or feel torn between them.
Authority over subreddit submissions must be distinguished from authority over placements when a moderator enforces a megathread rule.
Public consolidation operates alongside a separate chat channel, so containing submissions does not concentrate every design decision in the megathread.
An invitation establishes intended coordination in chat but does not expose how that chat decides or who participates.
Closure reporting and pride coexist, but the concepts do not establish that celebration caused members to preserve an account.
The successor follows closure reports without a cited claim that recording the original result caused the new attempt.
A successor project can remain an individual's contested attempt rather than become a room-wide decision to continue.
